property_snapshot.Name: The Sapphire Pools (Sea Ward Bathhouse)
property_snapshot.Notes: Northern Crown flagship multi-dome luxury bathhouse, Sea Ward, Waterdeep. \~240,000gp total investment, \~182,500gp/year revenue, 55% profit margin. White marble Corinthian portico facing west toward harbour (six columns — Sea Ward restraint reads as poverty, so ornament is permitted). Sapphire crystal panes grown by Seliara Frostwind (not cut/assembled — proprietary seed-crystal process, military-classification-adjacent). Central Dome: 80 ft across, 40-ft apex, main communal pool at body temperature (40-ft diameter, 4-6 ft deep, dark blue-gray floor), crystal 'clouds' overhead scatter blue light by day and bioluminescent magelight by night (dome glows like a jellyfish). Acoustic architecture absorbs high frequencies — voices soften, footsteps disappear, two nobles whisper 3 ft apart and an attendant 4 ft away hears nothing while an attendant 6 ft away at the calibrated focal point hears everything. Secondary Domes (40 ft each): Warm Room (east, rosemary/lavender rotating oils, relaxation pool, highest intelligence yield), Hot Room (south, heated steam, 15-minute sessions, reduced visibility makes clients feel unobserved — they aren't), Cold Plunge (north, Baen northern aqueduct mountain water direct, hard acoustic surfaces, sharp conversations carry to north-wall listening post). Sunset Chamber (west dome, 25 ft): sound-proofed by physical construction (double walls sand-filled), no windows, one door, three-knock-pause-two-knock staff signal. Peri takes criminal negotiations and intelligence debriefs here. Hidden infrastructure: listening posts behind each dome wall with 24-hour memory-recording crystals, 40-ft underground tunnel to Veil property 2 blocks south, money integration via Dorothea Varnilly. Two private Baen aqueducts (northern mountain springs feeding cold plunge + filtration, Loudwater Delimbiyr feeding heating reservoir) with six-stage hexagonal Baen Construction filtration. Primary competitor: The Silken Rest (Sea Ward, 20 years, poaching staff at 20% raises, suspected unproven perpetrator of the 3-day sewage-contamination shutdown). At night the dome glows blue — visible from ships entering Waterdeep harbour and from three Sea Ward blocks away — unintentional (Seliara designed crystal for interior optics) but Peri increased magelight intensity after dark once she recognized the marketing value.
